core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix academic rigor with modern SaaS clean aesthetics.
Content is King: The form is the hero. Minimize distraction.
Zoom In: Focus on the input field interaction.
Negative Space: Generous padding (p-8 to p-12) to create a premium feel.

structure.header: Sticky or fixed top, z-50, glassmorphic or solid beige

Card.name: RegistrationCard
Card.style: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-[0_20px_50px_-12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] border border-gray-100/50 overflow-hidden relative

Input.name: PremiumInput
Input.style: h-12 bg-gray-50 border-gray-200 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 rounded-lg transition-all duration-200 text-base placeholder:text-gray-400
Input.label_style: block mb-2 text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 tracking-wide

Select.name: PremiumSelect
Select.style: h-12 bg-gray-50 border-gray-200 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/20 rounded-lg transition-all duration-200 text-base

Button.name: ProceedButton
Button.style: h-14 w-full bg-[#1A73E8] hover:bg-[#1557B0] text-white font-bold text-lg rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/30 hover:shadow-blue-500/50 transition-all duration-300 transform hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:translate-y-0

Checkbox.name: ConfirmationCheckbox
Checkbox.style: h-5 w-5 border-2 border-gray-300 rounded text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500 transition-colors

Header.style: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 h-16 flex items-center justify-between px-6 md:px-12 bg-[#F5F2E9]/80 backdrop-blur-md z-40 border-b border-gray-200/50

assets.fonts: Import Manrope and Inter from Google Fonts

interactions.hover: Subtle lift (-1px) and shadow increase for cards/buttons
interactions.loading: Skeleton loaders for initial load, spinner on button click
interactions.validation: Real-time inline validation with red-500 text and shake animation

accessibility.labels: All inputs must have visible labels or aria-labels

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'use-toast.js' (located in /app/frontend/src/hooks/use-toast.js) or 'sonner' (if available) for notifications.
Implement the form using react-hook-form and zod for validation.
Ensure the 'Active WhatsApp number Required' note is visible under the Phone field.
Use a 2-column grid layout for the form fields on desktop, single column on mobile.
Header must contain 'BluBridge' text logo on left and 'Logout' link on right.
Do NOT use gradients for the background. Keep it solid #F5F2E9 as requested.
Add 'data-testid' to all inputs and buttons.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Manrope'.
Component reuse: Check /app/frontend/src/components/ui/ before creating new ones.
